baseline.working_tree_parent: Validated, uncommitted refund-review iteration, 2863 passed/3 skipped/core93.26%.
baseline.note: The head commit alone does not include the already-validated refund fix; cache work follows that saved source snapshot.

issue: Shared L0 and L1 answer replay skipped applicable user/session context; unavailable history could be mistaken for empty and allow shared writes.

implementation_contract.read_and_write: Anonymous with no active task context and, when configured, a successful empty history read. Unconfigured history feature is distinct from failed configured history.
implementation_contract.sticky_veto: shared_cache_blocked propagates context/unknown-history denial through the turn and write gates; begin_turn resets it but false does not prove history empty.

strict_history_api.signature: (self, session_id: 'int', limit: 'int' = 50, include_summary: 'bool' = False, *, raise_on_error: 'bool' = False) -> 'list[ChatMessage]'
strict_history_api.return_contract: list[ChatMessage], unchanged; factory maps to list[LLMMessage], unchanged; no tuple protocol
strict_history_api.strict_database_failure: original exception re-raised, preserving its type and identity

implementation_contract.summary: Only nonempty valid summaries replace covered raw turns; invalid summary-only history raises unknown on strict reads.
implementation_contract.memo: Memo only for nonempty turn_id and keyed by (session_id,turn_id); one entry can be evicted by concurrent turns, so no at-most-once snapshot claim.
implementation_contract.optional_config: Public generation/direct nodes normalize absent configurable data locally, preserving failure markers without mutating input state.

before.observed: Facts, raw history, summary history, provider exception and actual strict database OperationalError all returned route_after_cache=hit in normal/stream. Anonymous context-free responses already hit correctly, but never consulted history to prove eligibility.

scenarios: Cold anonymous grounded standard answer, followed by a fresh context-free anonymous cache hit
Identified Premium customer using durable UserFactRecord, compared with cache-disabled service
Anonymous existing Premium raw message history, compared with cache-disabled service
Anonymous existing nonempty system summary history, compared with cache-disabled service
History provider raises RuntimeError: skip replay and shared write, while fresh generation stays available
Actual SQLite history SELECT raises OperationalError through strict ChatMessagePersister read: skip replay and shared write

independent_evidence.healthy_cold: 1 local provider generation; history provider read once; real grounded answer populates one AnswerCacheService Redis entry.
independent_evidence.anonymous_hit: 0 local provider generations, 1 cache backend GET, 1 history provider read, no user-fact lookup; same source-version citation snapshot returned and persisted.
independent_evidence.known_context: Cache route miss; no cache backend GET or SET; exactly1 local generation as in the uncached control. Original model prompt contains Premium context, and healthy history is read once per turn. Identified-user facts are read through real SQLite persister.
independent_evidence.summary: The actual generated prompt includes a system message beginning Previous conversation:, supplied by real get_history(include_summary=True,raise_on_error=True).
independent_evidence.unavailable_context: Actual exception type is recorded for cached and uncached session IDs. Fresh generation is independently observed rather than inferred from equal response prose; no shared cache write occurs after the failure.
independent_evidence.durability_and_citations: Every turn is read back from SQLite. Durable assistant content equals visible normal/stream content; metadata citations equal the returned snapshot with document warranty-policy, version warranty-v1, chunk warranty-chunk-1, original excerpt and page2.
independent_evidence.shared_answer_integrity: Context-aware output never replaces the shared standard answer; Redis SET calls are independently counted and forbidden on contextual/unknown-history turns.

real_components: SQLite users/sessions/messages/user_facts with foreign keys enabled
local_IO_seams: In-memory Redis command surface and fixed KB epoch
LLMServiceBase provider fixture recording original prompts and deterministic streamed chunks
l0_real_graph.fault_injection: SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute raises OperationalError only inside the real strict history read; persistence/readback remain available outside that read.
limits: This file covers L0 only. Actual SemanticCacheService/L1 fixture validation is delegated to root/independent audit; root unit tests cover the common gate.
No HTTP/SSE framing, production database, real Redis TTL/concurrency, vector embedding/reranking, or live-model semantic quality is claimed.
QUERY_REWRITE_ENABLED is disabled only in this test fixture to isolate generation counts from the optional extra rewrite call.
Nonempty summaries are covered here; empty/whitespace-summary strict-read behavior is separately verified by the history-contract owner in /tmp/rag-20261028-cache-history-contract.json.

l1_real_service.components: Actual SemanticCacheService + deterministic embedding + local Redis command seam + actual NodeFactory.direct_response_node + synthetic local LLM
l1_real_service.verification_note: Root froze code; only optional-config probe rerun after its isolated wrapper normalization patch, as requested. Earlier14 actual L1 contrasts remain the recorded scoped verification.

history_contract.scope: History-read availability contract in ChatMessagePersister and its ChatServiceFactory binding; real SQLite regression tests, no change to node routing or graph history memo.

api.return_contract: list[ChatMessage], unchanged; factory maps to list[LLMMessage], unchanged; no tuple protocol

real_sqlite_assertions_exercised: A successful empty read returns [] in strict and default modes.
A valid summary is prepended and only covered raw turns are removed; both legacy invocation and strict mode tested.
After DROP TABLE messages, default reads return [], strict reads raise OperationalError rather than claiming successful empty history.
Empty and whitespace-only summaries cannot hide available raw customer turns, in legacy or strict reads.
If an invalid summary is the only readable history, default returns [] and strict include_summary raises RuntimeError containing history unavailable.

Factory-bound provider is invoked against actual SQLite: normal empty/summarized histories preserve list contents, missing messages table raises OperationalError, and invalid-summary-only history raises RuntimeError.

exception_identity_assertion.case: session maker raises one RuntimeError instance

checks.mypy: passed, no issues in 4 source files

compatibility_notes: API history calls keep default fail-open reads and default include_summary=False.
Invalid empty/whitespace summaries are intentionally ignored rather than suppressing readable raw turns.
Generators already catch unavailable context and can continue; a cache guard can now conservatively miss instead of treating read failure as proof of no history.
No changes to compressor output, node/history memo, global test discovery or shared-cache eligibility in these files.

independent_review.verdict: PASS: no remaining blocker in reviewed shared-cache context contract. Existing PII/output guards and cache allowlists remain necessary; this is not a full semantic-cache privacy audit.
limits: No prior context is not proof that arbitrary anonymous first-turn message or generated text contains no personal information. This targeted fix does not constitute a complete anonymous semantic-cache privacy audit.
Live model answer quality, production dependency recovery, distributed session serialization and cache capacity are outside this review.

first_full_run.failure_reason: Two old lifecycle assertions required an identified user after a business action to hit a shared answer. New contract correctly bypasses replay.
first_full_run.remediation: Retain cross-turn cleanup checks and assert context bypass; add separate anonymous stateless cache-hit cleanup controls. No skipped path, lowered threshold or disabled guard.

verification.overlap_note: These counts overlap; they are not added into a fabricated suite total.

final_default_full_suite.notes: Original PostgreSQL concurrency/locking and Docker recovery opt-in skips; existing short JWT test signing-key warnings. No lowered gates or removed discovery paths.

limits: No HTTP, paid/live model, external Redis/vector service or production database in the new L0 cache fixture; the prior refund fixture independently covers two strict HTTP final-confirmation cases.
The Redis command and model/embedding boundaries are deterministic local seams; this is application cache eligibility evidence, not measured live-model answer quality.

Absence of prior context does not prove arbitrary anonymous first-turn input/output is safe for all shared-cache privacy concerns. Existing PII, output guards, intent allowlists, citation and epoch contracts remain required.
Generation remains best-effort when history is unavailable; blocking shared cache replay/write does not guarantee personalized accuracy during storage failure.
Concurrent session serialization, stable cross-node history snapshots, production dependency recovery, capacity and latency are not verified.
Validation used no deployment or production requests. Changes were committed afterwards at the user request; no push.

design_references.use: Separate thread-scoped conversation history and cross-session user facts.
Grade actual state, provider calls, cache I/O and persisted artifacts, rather than matching response shape alone.

Strengthen live probe result checks so handoff failure and unsupported policy prose cannot pass on text anchors alone.
